benefit_text: The scheme pays yearly academic allowance. Group 1 pays 13,000 rupees for hostellers and 7,000 rupees for day scholars. Group 2 pays 9,500 rupees and 6,500 rupees. Group 3 pays 6,000 rupees and 3,000 rupees. Group 4 pays 4,000 rupees and 2,500 rupees.
who_can_apply: Indian nationals from Scheduled Castes can apply after passing Matriculation Higher Secondary or higher examination. Parents income from all sources must not exceed 2,50,000 rupees per annum.
documents: Papers include Caste Certificate and Income proof. Papers also include Aadhaar Card and Bank Account Details.
how_to_apply: Applicants open the official NSP website and click New Registration under Applicant Corner. Registration starts with Mobile OTP and needs Aadhaar Details and Bank Account Details.
